summary.name: Treatment-Linked Follow-up and Home Reading Review
summary.description: Consume the initial follow-up interval selected by the linked treatment decision, request follow-up, and arrange care-team review of home readings. For medication changes, arrange seven-day home-average review two to four weeks after the change without reusing the initial-treatment table. Laboratory follow-up and missing-reading outreach are outside this template.
summary.section: 3.2 Decision Table 1; 3.6 Follow-up Contact and Outreach

parameters.name: medication_changed
parameters.description: Event fact, not a categorical DMN output: true for medication change and false for initial treatment selection.

source.source_text: For patients starting or changing medication, the seven-day home average should be reviewed two to four weeks after the change, in addition to the laboratory follow-up in Table 2.

parameters.name: lifestyle_only
parameters.description: Management fact indicating lifestyle modification alone; must agree with the selected initial treatment.

source.source_text: Patients managed with lifestyle modification alone should have their home readings reviewed at the follow-up visit scheduled under Table 1.

parameters.name: initial_follow_up_weeks
parameters.description: Numeric follow-up field supplied from the linked initial-treatment decision: 2 or 4 weeks for medication and 8 or 12 weeks for lifestyle-only treatment. Not used for medication changes.
